mapper.insert: insert into tlias.student(name, no, gender, phone, degree, id_card, is_college, address, graduation_date,clazz_id) values(#{stu.name}, #{stu.no}, #{stu.gender}, #{stu.phone}, #{stu.degree}, #{stu.idCard}, #{stu.isCollege}, #{stu.address}, #{stu.graduationDate}, #{stu.clazzId})
mapper.select: select s.id, s.name, s.no, s.gender, s.phone, s.degree, s.id_card, s.is_college, s.address, s.graduation_date, s.violation_count, s.violation_score, s.clazz_id, s.create_time, s.update_time from tlias.student as s inner join tlias.class as c on s.clazz_id = c.id where s.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE tlias.student SET name = #{stu.name}, no = #{stu.no}, gender = #{stu.gender}, phone = #{stu.phone}, degree = #{stu.degree}, id_card = #{stu.idCard}, is_college = #{stu.isCollege}, address = #{stu.address}, violation_count = #{stu.violationCount}, violation_score = #{stu.violationScore} WHERE id = #{stu.id}
mapper.select: select (case when s.degree = 1 then '初中' when s.degree = 2 then '高中' when s.degree = 3 then '大专' when s.degree = 4 then '本科' when s.degree = 5 then '硕士' when s.degree = 6 then '博士' else '其它' end) as name, count(*) as value from tlias.student as s inner join tlias.class as c on s.clazz_id = c.id group by s.degree;
select c.name as className, count(*) as data from tlias.student as s inner join tlias.class as c on s.clazz_id = c.id group by c.name
